name: quioteframework/propulsion
description: Propulsion is an object-relational mapping (ORM) for PHP, forked from Propel 1.

suggest.open-telemetry/api: Enables telemetry.enabled in the runtime configuration -- see docs/OBSERVABILITY.md
suggest.open-telemetry/sdk: Enables telemetry.enabled in the runtime configuration -- see docs/OBSERVABILITY.md
suggest.open-telemetry/exporter-otlp: Enables telemetry.enabled in the runtime configuration -- see docs/OBSERVABILITY.md
suggest.open-telemetry/sem-conv: Enables telemetry.enabled in the runtime configuration -- see docs/OBSERVABILITY.md
suggest.psr/http-client-implementation: Any PSR-18 HTTP client (e.g. guzzlehttp/guzzle, symfony/http-client) is needed to export OpenTelemetry spans over OTLP/HTTP

test:cleanup-containers: docker ps -aq --filter label=propulsion.test-container=true | xargs -r docker rm -f --
docker network ls -q --filter label=propulsion.test-container=true | xargs -r docker network rm --
